jobs.name: 종의 기사
jobs.description: A very restrained seamless breathing idle loop. Both feet remain planted at the exact same pixels throughout. The rigid armoured chest lifts only one pixel and settles, the lowered heavy polearm and shield drift at most one pixel with the breathing, and only the lowest cloth hem gently shifts one or two pixels. Keep the same ready stance, facing, perspective, proportions, silhouette, gear, pixel clusters and limited colours as the first frame. No step, no leap, no attack, no turning, no extra limb, no glow, no particles, no camera movement. Finish exactly in the original pose.

jobs.description: A restrained seamless waiting idle loop for a chain-bound hanging guardian. Keep the character's lowest foot and robe hem anchor at the exact same location; no horizontal travel. Retain every chain, arm, weapon and masked face in its original place and appearance. Preserve the first frame's facing, perspective, proportions, angular pixel clusters and limited colours. No walking, bouncing, attack, rotation, added glow or particles. End exactly at the starting pose.
